title: Ordinary finite reduction of the specified constant-completion pullback comparison
statement: Let C and C' be small sites with topologies J and J'. Let L:Sh(J)→Sh(J') have right adjoint V and preserve finite limits. Give a functor F.rings on commutative ring sheaves, algebraic inverse-image lifts F.algebra R whose underlying sheaves are L of the underlying sheaves, natural in ring-sheaf maps, and a natural constant-ring isomorphism F.constants:constant_J followed by F.rings ≅ constant_J'. These lifts have the transported ring and module operations of [def-weil-pbc-algebraic-inverse-image]. Let A be a commutative Noetherian ring, I an ideal and n a natural number. Write R=constant_J A, S_n=constant_J(A/I^(n+1)), B=lim_m S_m, with coefficient map phi:R→B and projections p_n:B→S_n as in [def-sfb-constant-completion-coefficient-data], and use primes for the analogous sheaves on J'. Let q_n:R→S_n and q'_n:R'→S'_n be the quotient maps. Define c:F.rings(B)→B' by its projection components F.rings(p_m) followed by F.constants at A/I^(m+1). For a coefficient map a:F.rings(O)→T write pull_a=(F.algebra O).modules followed by ordinary sheafified scalar extension along a. Put k=F.constants at A. Restriction is [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Let delta:Res(phi) followed by pull_k → pull_c followed by Res(phi') be the ordinary scalar comparison characterized by pullInsertion_k followed by the underlying map of delta equalling pullInsertion_c. Here pullInsertion_a is the inverse of the algebraic lift's underlying-sheaf isomorphism followed by the scalar-extension unit m↦1 tensor m. Then ordinary scalar extension along q'_n sends delta to a natural isomorphism of S'_n-module sheaves. No cochain complex or derived functor is used in this conclusion.

proof.text: The Noetherian constant-coefficient section and adic-limit results identify R/I^(n+1)R and B/I^(n+1)B with S_n on both sites. In particular these give the common-quotient pushout squares. Inverse image transports the source quotient square; the constant isomorphisms identify its finite quotient with Sprime_n and its constant ring with Rprime. The projection equation for c gives the compatibility of the B-projections.

proof.text: Choose the normalized scalar-extension presentations and module adjunctions induced by the supplied algebraic inverse images. The ordinary geometric module transport supplies the adjunctions; transport normalized presentations to the prescribed change functors using their object and map equations. The natural constant-ring isomorphisms transport the inverse-image R and S_n actions to the project constant actions.

proof.text: Apply ordinary_insertion_reduction_isIso with these common quotients. Its insertion hypothesis is the defining pullInsertion equation of ordinaryPullComparison, after the inverse-image moduleUnderlying identifications and scalar-extension unit adjunction. Transport the resulting natural isomorphism through the constant-ring and scalar-presentation isomorphisms from step 2. Equivalently, the source and target both identify with inverse image over B followed by change along c followed by pprime_n; their insertion units agree, so adjunction gives equality with reduced delta. Isomorphism is invariant under these conjugations.

theorem ordinaryReducedPull_isIso
    (V : Sheaf J' (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf J (Type u)) (adj : L ⊣ V)
    [PreservesFiniteLimits L] (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) :
    IsIso (Functor.whiskerRight (ordinaryPullComparison F A I)
      (change (quotient J' A I n)))
